==English== {{wp}} ===Alternative forms=== * {{alter|en|companie||obsolete}} ===Etymology=== {{root|en|ine-pro|*peh₂-}} From {{inh|en|enm|companye||a team; companionship}}, from {{der|en|fro|compaignie||companionship}} (Modern French: {{m|fr|compagnie}}), possibly from {{der|en|la-lat||*compania}}, but this word is not attested. {{cog|fro|compaignie}} is equivalent to {{cog|fro|compaignon}} (Modern French: {{m|fr|compagnon}}) + {{m|fro|-ie}}. More at {{m|en|companion}}. Displaced native {{noncog|ang|werod}}, {{m|ang|gefer}}, {{m|ang|getæl}}, and {{m|ang|hired}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{a|en|UK}} ** {{IPA|en|a=RP|/ˈkʌmp(ə)ni/}} *** {{audio|en|en-uk-company.ogg}} ** {{IPA|en|a=dialectal|/ˈkɒmp(ə)ni/}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈkʌmpəni/|a=US}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-company.ogg}} * {{rhymes|en|ʌmpni|ʌmpəni|s=2}} * {{hyphenation|en|com|pany}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun|~}} # A [[team]]; a group of people who work together for a common purpose. #: {{ux|en|a '''company''' of knights}} ## A group of [[performing]] [[artist]]s who put on [[show]]s together. ##: {{ux|en|a '''company''' of actors}} ## {{lb|en|nautical|military}} The crew of a [[ship]]. ##: {{ux|en|a ship's '''company'''}} ## {{lb|en|military}} A unit of approximately sixty to one hundred and twenty soldiers, typically consisting of two or three [[platoon]]s and forming part of a [[battalion]]. ##: {{ux|en|the boys in '''Company''' C}} ##* {{RQ:Bindloss Dust of Conflict|chapter=30|passage=It was by his order the shattered leading '''company''' flung itself into the houses when the Sin Verguenza were met by an enfilading volley as they reeled into the calle.}} ## A unit of [[firefighter]]s and their equipment. ##: {{ux|en|It took six '''companies''' to [[put out]] the fire.}} ## {{lb|en|espionage|informal}} An intelligence service. ##: {{ux|en|As he had worked for the CIA for over 30 years, he would soon take retirement from the '''company'''.}} ## {{lb|en|aviation|informal}} A specific [[aircraft]] or its [[airline]], usually used in air traffic communications to refer conveniently to another aircraft operated by the same airline. # A small group of birds or animals. # {{lb|en|legal}} An [[entity]] having [[legal]] [[personality]], and thus able to own [[property]] and to sue and be sued in its own name; a [[corporation]]. #: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:enterprise}} #: {{ux|en|a financial services '''company'''}} #* {{quote-book|en|author=[[w:Robert Barr (writer)|Robert Barr]]|title=Lord Stranleigh Abroad|chapter=4|url=http://openlibrary.org/works/OL1796924W |year=1913|passage=“{{...}} That woman is stark mad, Lord Stranleigh.{{...}}If she had her way, she’d ruin the '''company''' inside a year with her hare-brained schemes; love of the people, and that sort of guff.”}} ## {{lb|en|business}} Any [[business]], whether [[incorporated]] or not, that [[manufacture]]s or [[sell]]s [[product]]s (also known as [[goods]]), or provides [[services]] as a [[commercial]] [[venture]]. ##: {{ux|en|Marconi [[set up]] the '''company''' who made the first radios.}} ##* {{quote-journal|en|author=w:George Monbiot|volume=188|issue=23|page=19|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly |title=Money just makes the rich suffer|url=http://www.guardian.co.uk/commentisfree/2013/may/06/politics-envy-keenest-rich|date=2013-05-17|passage=In order to grant the rich these pleasures, the social contract is reconfigured. {{...}} The public realm is privatised, the regulations restraining the ultra-wealthy and the '''companies''' they control are abandoned, and Edwardian levels of inequality are almost fetishised.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20261011071319/https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2013/may/06/politics-envy-keenest-rich|archivedate=11 October 2026}} ##* {{RQ:Economist |title=Obama goes troll-hunting|url=http://www.economist.com/news/business/21579011-president-proposes-new-round-intellectual-property-reform-obama-goes-troll-hunting|date=2013-06-08|volume=407|issue=8839|page=95|passage=According to this saga of intellectual-property misanthropy, these creatures [patent trolls] roam the business world, buying up patents and then using them to demand extravagant payouts from '''companies''' they accuse of infringing them. Often, their victims pay up rather than face the costs of a legal battle.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170629210715/http://www.economist.com/news/business/21579011-president-proposes-new-round-intellectual-property-reform-obama-goes-troll-hunting|archivedate=29 June 2017}} ##* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Jackie Wattles|title=Some Old Spice and Secret deodorants recalled after cancer-causing chemical is detected|url=https://www.cnn.com/2021/11/26/business/old-spice-secret-deodorant-recall-benzene|date=2021-11-26|passage=The '''company''' added it has not “received any reports of adverse events,” but it’s moving forward with the recall out of “an abundance of caution.”|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260220151128/https://www.cnn.com/2021/11/26/business/old-spice-secret-deodorant-recall-benzene|archivedate=20 February 2026}} ## The members of a partnership business who are not listed in the company's name; unnamed individuals in an entourage or other group. ##: {{ux|en|Smith, Capitano and '''Company'''}} ##: {{ux|en|Here come Will, Martin and '''company'''.}} # {{lb|en|uncountable}} [[companionship|Companionship]]. #: {{ux|en|I treasure your '''company'''.}} #* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=I|page=2|passage=He used to drop into my chambers once in a while to smoke, and was first-rate '''company'''. When I gave a dinner there was generally a cover laid for him. I liked the man for his own sake, and even had he promised to turn out a celebrity it would have had no weight with me.}} ## {{lb|en|uncountable}} One or more social [[visitor]](s) or [[companion]](s). ##: {{ux|en|Keep the house clean; I have '''company''' coming.}} ##* {{quote-book|en|author=w:Charles Johnstone|title=The Reverie; or, A Flight to the Paradise of Fools|url=http://books.google.com.sg/books?id=1mAzAQAAMAAJ&pg=PA202|volume=2|location=Dublin|publisher=Printed by Dillon Chamberlaine|year=1762|page=202|oclc=519072825|passage=At length, one night, when the '''company''' by ſome accident broke up much ſooner than ordinary, ſo that the candles were not half burnt out, ſhe was not able to reſiſt the temptation, but reſolved to have them ſome way or other. Accordingly, as ſoon as the hurry was over, and the ſervants, as ſhe thought, all gone to ſleep, ſhe ſtole out of her bed, and went down ſtairs, naked to her ſhift as ſhe was, with a deſign to ſteal them {{...}}}} ##* {{RQ:Travers Cuckoo in the Nest|chapter=5|passage=The departure was not unduly prolonged. In the road Mr. Love and the driver favoured the '''company''' with a brief chanty running. “Got it?—No, I ain't, 'old on,—Got it? Got it?—No, 'old on sir.”}} ## {{lb|en|figurative}} One or more other person(s) who are nearby, are approaching, or are (e.g. covertly) watching, especially if they may have hostile intentions (like [[adversary|adversaries]] or [[rival]]s). ##: {{ux|en|Get your guns ready: intel said there'd be no hostiles in the area, but it looks like we've got '''company'''.}} ##: {{ux|en|I thought we'd be the only ones exploring this abandoned tunnel system today, but judging by that light up ahead, it looks like we've got '''company'''.
